Name: (AT) Shih-Tzu
Author: DarkMagCat
Description:
So, this is my first mod, and I am *so* nervous about it... Anyway.  I've always wanted to have a Shih-Tzu in the game to play with, but there were no Mods to make my dream a reality!  So, I decided to make one, and wouldn't you know it, but this is the *perfect* time for this as it's the Stardew Valley Modfest!

The mod lets you change your dog to a black and white Shih-Tzu using Alternative Textures.  If this mod works, I'll look into creating a Content Patcher variant of it as well!

Special thanks to spacesheepcaptain's mod "[AT] Yet another dog mod" for the base dog sprites (specifically file "texture_15") that I used for my creation!

Enjoy!
